Agoge never redistributes Windows.

Metasploitable 2 is a deliberately vulnerable Ubuntu 8.04 VM from Rapid7. Agoge downloads the official 2.0.0 release from SourceForge; it is already installed, so it boots straight to the console (log in as msfadmin / msfadmin). Keep it on isolated lab networks only.

OPNsense is free and open software (BSD 2-clause) from Deciso. Agoge downloads the official 26.7 nano image from pkg.opnsense.org; it is already installed, so it boots straight to the console (log in as root / opnsense and change the password). It grows to fill its disk on first boot.

pfSense Community Edition is free and open software (Apache 2.0) from Netgate. Agoge downloads the official 2.7.2-RELEASE installer from Netgate's download mirror; it installs by hand from the console. Later CE releases ship only through Netgate's online installer, so upload a newer ISO yourself if you need one.

Security Onion is free and open software from Security Onion Solutions. Agoge downloads the official 3.3.0-20260911 ISO from download.securityonion.net. It installs by hand from the console; an Eval install wants 4 vCPUs, 8 GB of memory, and 200 GB of disk.

VyOS rolling is free and open software (GPL) from VyOS Networks. Agoge downloads the 2026.10.17-0025 nightly ISO from the vyos-nightly-build GitHub releases that vyos.net links to. VyOS publishes no SHA-256, so the catalog's hash is from a download whose minisign signature verified against the vyos.net key. It boots a live system (log in as vyos / vyos); run install image from the console. VyOS prunes old nightly builds from GitHub, so this download can stop working; if it does, upload a VyOS ISO yourself with Custom ISO.
